desc: Naming a new Boki (scripts/core/kin_names.gd, scripts/ui/name_step.gd). The suggested name is a root from the species' own name (its first syllable, from content/kin) plus one of the endings. Typed names are checked against rude: any of these letters inside the name (case and spaces ignored) and the name is not kept.
max_len_doc: Letters a name may have (the text box stops there).
